description: Extract database query patterns into a data access layer ('repository' pattern). Currently, 178+ `getDb()` calls are spread across 21 server files with repetitive query building (filtering by userId, joining relations). Create reusable repository classes (e.g., `AppRepository`, `AlertRepository`) with common methods like `getUserItems()`, `getById()`, `update()` to encapsulate Drizzle-ORM queries.
